question: X6: report section 8.5 says the editor of a pulled Overleaf change is 'unknown': is that right?

solvers.answer: F2: the git bridge records the editor per Overleaf version (SnapshotInfo carries the user); section 8.5's 'unknown' is carried over from the GitHub-sync docs.
F6: the commit author is the most recent editor of each batch, per Overleaf's git integration docs.

refutation.note: Overleaf's git-integration page: 'the author of the most recent change will be listed as the author of the commit'; the local clone's Overleaf-side commits carry author jamesdchen01 and committer node. Whether two editors are split into separate commits is unverified.

final_answer: Correct section 8.5: the editor is the bridge commit's author, the last editor of each pull batch; exact when one person edited between pulls.
answer_short: Report section 8.5 corrected: Overleaf records the last editor before each pull.

actions.detail: Section 8.5 editor attribution; done in commit 74d45cd.
